configFields.connectivityMode.help.defaultMessage: How quickly commands reach a locked phone on battery.

configFields.connectivityMode.more.defaultMessage: Older agents ignore it. Battery-saver holds the live connection only while the screen is on or the device is charging, so a command sent to a locked phone on battery waits for the next heartbeat (about 10 minutes, longer in deep Doze) or for the screen to come on. Always-on keeps the connection up 24/7, so commands such as Lock, Ring or Wipe reach a locked phone without waiting for the heartbeat, at a battery cost. The mode set here is applied again when the configuration changes, the device restarts or the agent updates, so a mode set on a device page lasts only until then. To keep a lost device on Always-on, set its configuration to Always-on (or move the device to one that is). To switch devices back, choose Battery-saver; — (not managed) leaves each device as it is.
